# Jev Ultrafast provenance

Upstream: https://github.com/browser-use/jev-ultrafast

Base commit: `1231850a0bf1a0c0341fe408ef1668dbbfdfac46` (0.1.0).
Imported from the locally installed checkout on 2026-09-20. MIT; see LICENSE.

Pre-existing local changes retained: explicit UTF-8 snapshot loading; optional
TypeSafe evaluation gateway; confidence/metadata compatibility. The original demo
UI is not included. Credentials, virtual environments and traces are not copied.

BioinformaticsHUB extensions: injectable browser and exact-value resolver, durable
action callbacks, uploads, native form submission metadata, bounded scroll labels,
nested scrolling and open shadow roots. Product-specific
site rules, lifecycle, recovery and outcome verification live outside this package.
Model HTTP retry waits are bounded and interruptible by the worker lifecycle.
